internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: TORONTO, Canada – Neo Performance Materials Inc. (“Neo” or the “Company”) [TSX: NEO; OTCQX: NOPMF] today announced that the European Commission has designated “Silmet 2.0”, the modernization program for Neo’s rare earth separation facility in Sillamäe, Estonia, as a Strategic Project under the European Union’s Critical Raw Materials Act (“CRMA”). The Commission selected Silmet 2.0 as one of 46 projects in 16 Member States, and it is the only rare earth processing project in this selection.
